**Intercepts.** The global intercept combines an arm-blind anchor from pooled pre-randomisation t1 scores with a free zero-centred offset. The anchor uses the fitted link's linear-predictor scale. Wave deviations sum to zero, avoiding the weakly identified combination of a free global intercept and free wave offsets (#389 finding 2). The anchor uses this study's baseline data, so the priors table labels the offset as empirical Bayes.
